verdict.rationale: Fly.io claims org-wide service connections without manual token pasting and fine-grained credential rotation (fly-io-docs-11/12/13), suggesting some built-in credential/service wiring, but this is scoped to its newer Sprites/agent sandbox product rather than general SDK-free bindings for databases/storage. Community evidence shows friction with basic integrations like Postgres attach failing and no native object storage equivalent (fly-io-comm-13, fly-io-comm-18), undercutting the 'minimal boilerplate' promise.
